title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
body: Reservations on flexible rates may be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours prior to scheduled check-in time (14:00 property local time). Cancellations received within 24 hours of arrival or non-arrivals (no-shows) are subject to a fee equivalent to the first night's room charge plus applicable taxes. Advance purchase and non-refundable promotional rates are non-refundable upon booking confirmation.

title: Check-in Procedures & Requirements
body: Check-in commences at 14:00 hours. Guests must present a valid government-issued photographic identification (Passport, National ID Card, or Driver's License) along with a valid credit card matching the reservation holder's name. A security authorization hold will be temporarily placed upon check-in for incidental charges.

title: Check-out Policy
body: Check-out time is 12:00 noon. Guests requiring late check-out should notify the front desk at least 24 hours in advance. Late check-out until 15:00 is subject to room availability and may incur an additional charge. Departures after 18:00 will be billed as a full night's stay.

title: Children & Extra Bedding Policy
body: Children aged 11 and under stay complimentary when sharing existing bedding with adult guardians. Complimentary infant cribs are provided upon advance request for children aged 2 and under. Extra rollaway beds for older children or additional adults are available in select room categories for an additional surcharge.

title: Pet Accommodation Policy
body: Designated pet-friendly Garden Terrace Suites welcome well-behaved canine companions up to 15 kg. A dedicated pet fee covers deep sanitation and includes a plush pet bed, food/water bowls, and artisanal welcome treats. Pets must remain leashed in public pathways and are not permitted inside pool areas or indoor dining venues.

title: Guest Privacy & Data Protection
body: We respect your personal privacy. All personal information collected during reservation, check-in, and online transactions is protected using enterprise-grade 256-bit SSL encryption. We never sell or distribute guest data to third-party advertisers. Payment card details are tokenized securely through Stripe PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant infrastructure.

title: General Terms & Conditions
body: By booking accommodation at our property, guests agree to abide by all house rules, safety regulations, and noise policies. The property maintains a peaceful atmosphere for all guests; quiet hours are observed from 22:00 to 07:00. The property reserves the right to terminate stays for disruptive behavior without refund.
